scope: CpuFreqProbe.cpp governor observability only; no hardware qualification

checks: Startup logs initial frequencies before CPU/L3 votes
Entry logs CPU before initial recount sampling
First nonzero tick logs once, including after a zero-dt tick
Current CPU sampled for each startup/entry/first/steady row, with simulated migration across eight CPUs
Exactly two dynamic-recount rows at 10s and 20s; five total getter calls over 20s
First-tick output does not reset the statistics window
Missing mapping, disabled domain and unusable LUT reported unavailable
Thread-start failure logs actual error without retry or deallocation
MMIO, ring and exported-stat traces identical to hash-matched original
host_tests.method: Whole production translation unit executed with kernel/IOKit/clock/MMIO stubs; ARM DSB replaced only for host execution by a sequentially consistent fence; temporary harness and binaries removed

target_compile.checks: Existing SDK/arm64e/PAC/LC_BUILD_VERSION recipe; -Wall -Wextra -Werror; no new core import exceptions

current_cpu_getter.reason_for_local_declaration: Current board compile recipe lacks osfmk include root; Kernel SDK omits cpu_number.h. Exact pinned C declaration avoids build-recipe or core changes.
current_cpu_getter.semantics: Logical CPU at the instant the getter is called; a log does not pin the thread to that CPU.

prior_log_evidence.cause_of_subsequent_silence: unknown; populated mode-4 votes support initial governor execution. Checkpoints added before recount sampling and after first nonzero tick; no hardware frequency pass claimed.
